description: This file defines a React component 'NumericCellRenderer' used for rendering numeric cells in a data grid, including styling, calculations for bar chart visualizations, and handling of theme and formatting.

methods.name: cellWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of the cell background for horizontal bar chart based on value and range.

methods.name: cellOffset
methods.description: Calculates the left margin (offset) for horizontal bar chart elements based on value and range.

methods.name: cellBackground
methods.description: Determines the background color for the cell based on value and theme settings.
